{{Quote|Look, one of ours, out of the main hold!|Wendik spots Anakin Skywalker's fighter|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
'''Arven Wendik''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] and [[pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. After the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] was [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY]], Wendik flew in an [[N-1 starfighter]] as [[Bravo 3]] during the [[Battle of Naboo]]. They and the rest of Bravo Flight were tasked with destroying ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]'', a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] controlling the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]]; however, they found themselves unable to damage it until the young boy [[Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the [[battleship]] from within. Wendik survived the battle and celebrated the victory.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Ric Olié|Fighters straight ahead!|Arven Wendik|Roger, Bravo Leader.|Dineé Ellberger|Roger, Bravo Leader.|attr=[[Ric Olié]], a pilot, and Dineé Ellberger, during the battle against the Droid Control Ship over Naboo|audio=ObviousFighters-TPM.flac|src=<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[Lieutenant]] Arven Wendik<ref name="BMF" /> was a [[human]] who served as a [[pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps|Royal Space Fighter Corps]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] during the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|occupation]] of Naboo<ref name="Episode I" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Wendik flew as part of [[Bravo Squadron]], assisting [[commander]] [[Ric Olié]], alongside fellow lieutenants [[Dineé Ellberger]] and [[Lutin Hollis]]. Only a few of the pilots avoided capture during the Trade Federation's invasion, but after Olié and [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] returned from seeking aid on the planet [[Coruscant]], some of the captive pilots were then freed and a plan was formed to retake Naboo with the aid of the native [[Gungan]]s.<ref name="BMF" />

While the [[Gungan Grand Army]] distracted the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]], Amidala led a force including Wendik and the rest of Bravo Flight into [[Theed]], the [[capital]] of Naboo. The group used hidden passages to reach the [[Theed Hangar]], where they destroyed the [[battle droid]]s standing guard so that Bravo Flight could launch the [[N-1 starfighter]]s being kept in the [[hangar]]. Wendik piloted one of the [[starfighter]]s as Bravo Flight then left Naboo's [[atmosphere]] in order to try and destroy the ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]'', a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] that was controlling all of the Federation's [[droid]] forces. Wendik flew as [[Bravo 3]] during the ensuing battle, in which the Naboo pilots engaged the [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] deployed by the [[battleship]], but found that their target's [[deflector shield]] was too strong for them to cause any damage.<ref name="Episode I" />

However, the pilots were surprised when the Trade Federation vessel began to detonate from within despite their lack of success in damaging it. The destruction had been instead caused by the young child [[Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], who had been brought to the battle by a N-1 starfighter's [[autopilot]] and ended up flying inside the ''Vuutun Palaa'' and then destroying it from within. Wendik spotted Skywalker's fighter exiting the detonating battleship after which they, Skywalker, and the rest of Bravo Flight flew away from the ''Vuutun Palaa'' and celebrated as it exploded. The ship's destruction caused the deactivation of the Federation's droid forces below on Naboo and led to a victory over the Trade Federation and the liberation of the world.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Anakin Skywalker|Whoo!|Arven Wendik|Yeah!|Lutin Hollis|Hee-hee!|attr=Skywalker and the surviving pilots of Bravo Flight celebrate|src=<ref name="Episode I" />}}
Arven Wendik had dark skin and [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s. After destroying the ''Vuutun Palaa'', they celebrated with a quieter exclamation as other pilots cheered and hollered.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Equipment==
While flying an N-1 starfighter in the Battle of Naboo, Wendik wore a brown [[Fighter Corps Flying Helmet]] with the flying [[goggles]] down and the orange [[flying jacket]] of the corps's uniform.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arven Wendik was portrayed by [[Clarence Smith]] in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The character was credited only as "Fighter Pilot Bravo 3" in the film.<ref name="Episode I" />

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] their full name was used in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 31|thirty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine, which was published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="BMF" /> around [[August 5]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|31}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[2001]] ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Arven Wendik}}</ref>

In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Wendik appears during an adaptation of their scene from ''The Phantom Menace'', but is depicted with light skin rather than dark.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>
